en: Sepia-toned historical view of a broad town square bordered by older houses and industrial-style buildings with chimneys on the left, and several multi‑story townhouses on the right. Ornate street lamps stand in the open square. The printed captions at the top read "Limbach i. Sa." on the left and "Marktplatz." on the right, indicating this is the market square of Limbach in Saxony.
